description: This file defines the MultipartUploader class for handling multipart uploads to AWS Glacier, including methods for creating upload states, managing parts, and computing hashes.

classes.name: MultipartUploader
classes.description: Handles multipart upload operations to AWS Glacier, including state management, part creation, and hashing.

methods.name: getStateFromService
methods.description: Creates an UploadState object by querying Glacier for existing upload parts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartUploader with client, source, and configuration.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration for upload commands and identifiers.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Validates and returns the part size for uploads.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Creates a data part from the source stream, computing hashes.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a part upload, updating the upload state.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters for initiating a multipart upload.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters for completing a multipart upload, including hash calculation.

methods.name: decorateWithHashes
methods.description: Wraps a stream with hashing streams to compute SHA256 and TreeHash.

methods.name: parseRange
methods.description: Parses a Glacier range string into part index and size.
